description: What a listed US company spent on federal lobbying, per quarter, from the Lobbying Disclosure Act reports (lda.gov): its own in-house expenses and the income outside lobbying firms reported from it, kept apart, plus its most recent reports with links. Give ticker or company. Without either, a ranking of the listed companies with the largest own lobbying expenses over the last four quarters.

company.description: Part of the company name, e.g. Nvidia. Use ticker when you know it.

filings.description: How many recent reports to list. Default 10.

limit.description: Without a company: how many companies to rank. Default 20.

quarters.description: How many quarters, newest first. Default 8.

name: get_company_lobbying
title: Lobbying by listed US companies (Lobbying Disclosure Act)
